sources.title: Quantum Computation for Pricing Caps using the LIBOR Market Model
sources.snippet: The LIBOR Market Model (LMM) is a widely used model for pricing interest rate derivatives. While the Black-Scholes model is well-known for pricing stock derivatives such as stock options, a larger portion of derivatives are based on interest rates instead of stocks. Pricing interest rate derivatives used to be challenging, as their previous models employed either the instantaneous interest or forward rate that could not be directly observed in the market.
